name: Mushroom Town Townstreet
terrain_style: Interior: two-storey mushroom-house cutaway (insideGS/house1): cream plaster walls framed by honey-coloured timber posts/beams, plank floors, orange mushroom-cap roof shell with stone-arched front. Outside the west wall a short grassySoil yard strip (grass over olive-brown dirt).

landmarks.what: Round-topped orange plank exit door on the house's west wall (prop/door/0)
Ground-floor room wall panel with timber posts and a small wall shelf (house1/basic/4)
Mushroom-house cutaway shell: orange cap, cream walls, stone-arched entrance (house1/basic/0)

notes: Portals recovered from raw WZ because the parsed API JSON has null entries: https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Map/Map/Map0/000020001.img/portal/<n> (fields pn, pt, tm, tn, x, y). All portals here are therefore sourced, not inferred.

Landmark x,y are WZ obj anchors from https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Map/Map/Map0/000020001.img/<layer>/obj/<n>; sprites identified via https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Map/Obj/<oS>.img/<l0>/<l1>/<l2>/0. API-reported sprite origins were all exactly (w/2,h/2), so treat anchors as roughly sprite-centre; footprints are +-half sprite size. Where one landmark merges several objects, x,y is their approximate mean.
tiers[].y_left/y_right are MapleStory y (down is positive). Tier ids are local to this file. Ladders: y1 = top end, y2 = bottom end (raw data order); from_tier = bottom tier, to_tier = top tier.
v8 has zero mob spawns in this map (life contains only NPCs).
Despite the name "Mushroom Town Townstreet", v8 data is a two-storey mushroom-house interior (informally Sen's house, since Sen is its only NPC). The slug is kept as given.
Spawn point "sp" at (-329,241) is OUTSIDE in the yard (T1); arrival via 20000:in01 lands at out00 (-167,244) inside, next to the door. returnMap is 20001 itself.

Walls/ceilings (not tiers): ground-floor ceiling y=69 (x -141..129); door lintel wall x=-141 from y=69 down to 152 (leaves a ~94 px doorway above T2); east wall x=129 (y 69..246); upper room box x -142..138, floor 47, ceiling -117.
Data artifact excluded from tiers: the y=275 ground continues under the house floor and east to x=489 (fh 23,2-7,9,12,13), 29 px below T2; not intended play space.
No minimap for this map in the API (/api/GMS/8/map/20001/minimap returns 404). Geometry identical in v22 and v28; v28 parses out00 -> 20000:in01 directly (https://maplestory.io/api/GMS/28/map/20001).
